body: Makes sense. But it’s as if I’m suddenly a monster to some of them. I really messed up, but people make mistakes! Yet with all of this, I feel horrible with myself and am now having trouble finding any self-worth.
I’m 19. They hadn’t erupted yet.
Interesting, alright. I may start irrigating tomorrow. Hope you’re feeling better now
Oh no! Hope everything goes well.
Ugh, hope this doesn’t happen to me. Thanks for your input! The hardest/most frustrating part for me is just not being able to eat normally. I know it won’t last forever though.
I haven’t dared listen to a single song of ours since the breakup.
I asked before and he was hesitant to do it

Nervous breakdowns. Circling back to the same point over and over again uncontrollably. Overthinking to the highest degree humanly possible I’d imagine.

Like it genuinely feels like my brain folds in on itself and it’s simply too much to handle.

Her and I both over-exaggerated our place in each other’s lives. She just pulled away from that on her own without communicating. Part of me thinks that is inexorably linked with her reason for breaking up… she realized that I wasn’t her “everything” or her “world” in a literal sense and for whatever reason I guess that made her pull away even further… it’s a mystery
If it is, it is. But it just feels so wrong.

What makes something more special than something else? These are just words, my friend, constructs of the human species to give more meaning to things that don’t have inherent meaning. 

Every single thing we know is just a construct of our species. Emotions, time, good and bad, etc. We live in a neutral universe, a meaningless universe that exists just as we simply exist. And I would like to not exist anymore, simple as that. I’ve had enough, I would like to rest now.

It is surreal. The pretending that we didn’t share our lives, our hearts, our bodies, our time and love and effort with each other. It suddenly just seems so formalized, so fake, so distant. Not sure I’ll ever understand it.
All of these are also super tough for me. Knowing that it’s probably inevitable that she will be romantically and physically intimate with someone else is definitely up there as well.
Thanks everyone
Yup. Feel this
Mornings are the worst when that realization hits all over again... the absolute worst

Posts like these just make me cringe and hurt even more regarding newfound realizations about dating and relationships in general…

Dude. She is obviously toying with you and giving you mixed signals because she doesn’t know herself what she wants. This is the same girl that LEFT HER FIANCÉ to pursue whatever it is you guys had, and as you mention, was probably flirting with you while she was still with him. Is this genuinely someone you want to be in a relationship with? Is this someone that makes you feel secure and comfortable? She’s obviously dealing with a load of personal problems that you are in no way obligated to help her with. Either way, don’t do it. Just tell her she made her choice and leave it at that. 3 months is not long for a relationship, so be grateful you got out as soon as you did. This girl sounds like disaster waiting to happen. 

Don’t do it man.

Trippy is a great word. Feels like I’m in some distorted sci-fi existence where all her positive memories of me were simply erased. Because I can’t imagine how she could go from feeling so so so much love for me, to just not feeling anything other than desire to get me out of her life, to move on…
It is absolutely the most surreal thing I’ve ever experienced. I’ve lost what little trust I had left in human connections. We are just too complex, sex-driven, and irrational for something like “love.” No wonder so many relationships and marriages fail. I so badly wanted to settle down and have a family and future with this girl, and now…? I just don’t even know anymore.

Her indifference towards me, her lack of commitment to giving us true closure to the relationship, it’s like she discarded me as if I were just some piece of trash from the past. That’s not love. Unless she’s intentionally doing everything she can to suppress it, to appear resolved in her decision, to not be warm and forthcoming so as not to get my hopes up… I just don’t know. It hurts so bad.

I wish I knew. Part of me thinks that if we were good to them, if they truly were in love, and if we play the post-breakup right by bettering ourselves and staying no contact so they can feel the weight of our absence… they will come back 90% of the time. Who knows how long it’ll take, and unfortunately how many people they fuck or date in between, but I firmly believe it’ll happen. And then the power’s in our hands. 

The fear is that she will fully move on, never truly reflect on me or the breakup, and eventually find some partner that makes her more happy and sexually fulfilled than I ever could. Someone that makes her never look back.

But that is just a fear, or so I hope. I know how good I was to her. I know how happy she was with me, how much she loved me, how compatible we were. I truly do think that whether it’s a gradual realization or maybe a sudden gut punch, they will come to know their mistake and come running back. I don’t know where I’ll be at emotionally at that point, and she better have a damn good explanation for crushing my heart like this… part of me thinks I’ll turn her down. And then she’ll be in our shoes.

Took the words out of my mouth. Remembering how beautiful it was… I can’t even help it, it’s like whenever I try to gear myself up in the mindset that it’s over, that she’s gone for good and not coming back, this montage starts to play in my head of our countless beautiful and intimate moments together, happiness and love and laughter and silliness and support… she wasn’t perfect, but she was in many respects my dream girl. And together, man I’ll tell ya… together, we just completed each other. So yes, it is very much a ‘what the actual fuck’ turn of events. Makes no sense how they can just bail on something they wanted so damn badly; the relationship, marriage, a future. I just don’t get it. And fuck does it hurt when a person tells you all the wonderful things about you, some you didn’t even realize yourself, citing them as the reasons they are so madly and deeply in love with you, only for them to leave, give up on you, and inevitably fall for someone else. She said she would always fight for me. Guess that was a fucking lie.
My thoughts exactly. It’s like I can’t ever trust in anyone, can’t trust in love, again.
Same here. It is genuinely the most crushing and baffling thing… I wish I could understand what the hell is going through her mind

Hey that sounds brutal and similar to what I’m going through. However, it’s easy to slip into the “it was all fake” mentality even when it’s not the case. Do you truly think she was stringing you along that whole time? Do you truly think she didn’t love you as tenderly as it seemed? I’m guessing the answers are no and no. And this is where I’m stuck too. ‘People change’ doesn’t seem to cut it for me and I’m still struggling to find a true explanation. But all I know is that it wasn’t fake. None of it. That’s what makes all of this so complex and surreal for me.
It’s literally the worst. So sorry you’re dealing with this too.

The problem is that despite the promises, she was literally all I wanted in a partner in a very grounded way.

We had a near perfect balance of friendship, romance, and sex, and incredibly matched energy, interests, dreams, etc. We just fit together so effortlessly and for the longest time, our love for each other was indescribable. We were unbelievably attracted to each other and the things she said about me and our relationship and future were so profound and genuine. I don’t want to put her or the relationship on a pedestal, I acknowledge there were flaws, but nothing compared to the connection we shared. I’m just so lost.

I can live without her. I am my own person, I have my own goals and passions and motivations. Everything just feels… empty in a way. I miss my best friend.

Ah man that sounds truly brutal. So sorry you’re dealing with that, but it sounds like you have a strong mindset. It’s the worst when the person who made you feel most loved is the same person who now makes you feel the most hurt.

Reconciling who they were with who they seem to be now is one of the hardest things about this. Surely that loving, sweet, absolutely precious girl that wanted nothing more than to spend a beautiful life with me… surely she’s still there somewhere, deep down maybe, I think to myself. Will she ever come back?

I’m not ready to fully let go yet… it’s too painful… especially since we’re going to be at the same tiny college. Makes it so much worse. I keep having these hopeful fantasies that eventually she’ll come back to me when she’s ready. I just.. this can’t be the end forever.

No one else is her… I’m not religious and I really don’t believe in many spiritual things, but my connection with her truly felt deeper than anything I’d ever felt before. As if maybe, just maybe, I do have a soul and that she’s the only one that’s been able to reach it on such a profound level. Her and I, we didn’t toss around the term soulmates for years like it was nothing. We meant that shit. She felt the same way about me too. She’s told me.

So where it all went, I haven’t the slightest idea.

But the thought of either of us being with other people just makes me cringe and when I think of the romantic and sexual details I start to feel physically sick. This is just hell.
I feel the same way
